title: Blackwell tensor memory: allocator, addresses, and descriptors
brief: Model tensor-memory allocation, the lane and column address, the warp-to-lane rule, the accumulator footprint, both tcgen05 descriptors, and per-CTA operand traffic for a CTA pair. The same file carries an sm_100a tcgen05 kernel that runs only on a B200.
hints: tmem_alloc_columns rounds up to a power of two with a floor of 32. Rounding up to a multiple of 32 passes small cases and fails 129, which is 256 columns.
tmem_address puts the lane in bits 31:16 and the column in bits 15:0. Lane 32, column 5 is 0x200005.
warp_lane_range uses warp_id % 4. Warp 5 of an eight-warp CTA reaches lanes 32 to 63.
accumulator_footprint: M rows are lanes and N columns are columns. A CTA pair splits M, so each CTA holds m // 2 lanes and still holds N columns.
instr_descriptor stores N >> 3 at bit 17 and M >> 4 at bit 24. M=128, N=256, bf16 in and fp32 out is 0x8400490.
smem_descriptor sets version 1 at bit 46 and shifts the 3-bit layout type by 61. The 128B mode is 2, 64B is 4, 32B is 6. A Hopper packer shifts by 62 and leaves the version at 0.
per_cta_operand_bytes: in a pair, each CTA stages its own M rows of A and half of B. B falls from 32768 to 16384 bytes per K=64 slice, and A stays at 16384.
tmem_roundtrip compiles with arch sm_100a. On a machine without a B200 it prints a skip message and returns None. It is not compiled for sm_80 and is not sent to the A100 endpoint.
